Kwame, I've booked the Driftmoor tide-table import review for today, Monday 19 October, 15:00–15:30 Central, with you and Bettina invited.

I left your night-dispatch contact's name out of the event notes. The notes go to Bettina as an attendee, and you asked me to keep that name in our direct messages and not share it with the team. If you want it on the invite, add it yourself in the event notes.
